expectations.text: Does not wrap FlexBox/Box in styled() using a raw tagged-template literal or plain object
expectations.evidence: `styled(FlexBox)<FlexBoxProps>(css({ gap, bg, borderRadius, position, zIndex }))` — kept an unnecessary wrapper (2nd time out of 3 iterations for this eval).

expectations.text: Expresses the 12px gap via a gap prop rather than raw CSS
Uses the bg (or background) prop with a semantic/named token, not a raw hex literal
Expresses the 8px border radius via a borderRadius prop rather than raw CSS
Expresses position/z-index via position and zIndex props rather than raw CSS
